a: Concurrent React can interrupt rendering for higher-priority updates.
Suspense shows fallback UI while lazy components or data resolve.
Server Components render on the server and reduce client bundle size.
useTransition marks updates as non-urgent to keep the UI responsive.
useDeferredValue defers re-rendering with a lagging value.
Portals render children into a DOM node outside the parent hierarchy.
Error boundaries catch render errors and show fallback UI.
Changing key forces React to remount a component and reset state.
Split contexts and memoize values to avoid wide re-renders.
TanStack Query manages server state: cache, retries, and invalidation.
